snippet.title: Grand Theft Auto V launch: Thousands queue for midnight launch
snippet.description:
Grand Theft Auto V is expected to smash sales records, with queues around the block, after going on sale worldwide. Stores across the UK opened at midnight so gaming fans could get their hands on one of the most eagerly-anticipated releases. Online retailer Amazon has already sold out of the game, which reportedly cost around £170 million to make and market, more than many Hollywood blockbusters. Experts estimate it could generate £1 billion during its first year on sale, with gamers predicted to snap up a record-breaking 25 million copies. Report by Katie Lamborn.

snippet.description:

The atmosphere was buzzing, we spoke to the guys and gals in the queue and staff to get their thoughts on this blockbuster title from Rockstar Games.
